name: com.nexus.ads.levelplay
description: Unity LevelPlay (Ads Mediation package com.unity.services.levelplay 9.x) behind the com.nexus.ads core as its IAdProvider: rewarded and interstitial ad units, banner, impression-level revenue, the test suite, COPPA and GDPR forwarding.
